responsibility: Implements the PDP-11 backend’s executable target logic behind the declarations and RTL patterns in pdp11.h/pdp11.md. This file installs and defines target hooks for assembler output and section handling, argument passing and return-value conventions, trampoline emission for nested functions, register availability adjustments based on options such as FPU and assembler dialect, legality checks for constants and modes, register-mode and hard-register sizing rules, and instruction/address/RTX cost modeling used by later RTL stages. It also supplies PDP-11-specific floating-format encode/decode routines and assorted asm-output helpers for labels, definitions, address vectors, file prologue/epilogue, and named sections, making it the main C implementation of ABI, code-generation policy, and assembler-interface behavior for the target.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable C implementation for the PDP-11 port: it defines and installs target hooks, helper routines, floating-format encode/decode support, calling-convention logic, register-usage adjustments, and assembler/file-output functions referenced by the rest of the same-stem files. Unlike pdp11.h, which declares static target macros and ABI properties, pdp11.md, which declaratively describes RTL instruction patterns, and pdp11.opt, which only defines target command-line options, this file contains the backend’s runtime target logic.
